title: One-step configuration encoding language
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols. The one-step configuration language consists of Boolean strings $y$ for which there exist a Boolean string $x$ and natural numbers $c,c',s$ such that $y$ is the nested pair encoding of $x$ and the binary representations of $c,c',s$, and there are configurations $C,C'$ of $N$ on input $x$ such that $C$ lies in the window of size $s$ and has code $c$, $C'$ follows $C$ in one machine step, $C'$ also lies in that window, and $C'$ has code $c'$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols
